description: Full-text search over the host's AI-chat history (local BM25 index of claude / opencode / codex / cline / roo / kilo / zed / cursor / gemini / qwen / goose / continue transcripts). Returns ranked, cited snippets with session id + message position (`seq`) — follow up with session_get {provider, id, around_seq: seq} for the context. Much more token-efficient than pulling whole transcripts.

agent_id.description: Optional: ID of remote agent. If omitted, executes locally.

providers.description: Optional: restrict to these providers (e.g. ["claude", "opencode"]); empty = all

query.description: Search query (terms, file names, error messages…); BM25-ranked

name: session_search
